register.labelZh: PASS 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: PASS 表達可以描述人或車輛經過、從上方越過、路經某地,以及時間逐漸過去。；你可以 pass messages on、pass papers out、pass food round、pass stories down,以及 passcontrol over to somebody。；pass something up 可以表示放棄機會;pass somebody over 可以表示沒有挑選某人;passsomebody by 則可描述機會與某人擦身而過。；pass off 可以描述活動如何進行;pass through 可以描述一段經歷;pass out 表示昏倒;passaway 則是表示某人去世的較委婉說法。
register.summaryEn: PASS expressions can describe people or vehicles going past, moving overhead, travelling through a place and time going by. You can pass messages on, pass papers out, pass food round, pass stories down and pass control over to somebody. Pass something up describes refusing a chance. Pass somebody over describes not choosing them, while pass somebody by can describe opportunities being missed. Pass off describes how an event happens, pass through describes an experience, pass out means to faint, and pass away is a gentle way to say that somebody died.
contextsZh: 清楚談論移動、路線和時間
說明事物如何在人與人或不同世代之間傳遞
描述選擇、錯過機會和不公平決定
談論活動、困難時期和較敏感的人生轉變
contextsEn: Talk clearly about movement, routes and time
Explain how things move from one person or generation to another
Describe choices, missed chances and unfair decisions
Talk about events, difficult periods and sensitive life changes
register.formalZh: 閱讀整句,選出意思相同的 PASS 表達。
register.formalEn: Read the whole sentence and choose the PASS expression that gives the same meaning.

fixedVariable.fixedZh: 閱讀整句,選出意思相同的 PASS 表達。
fixedVariable.fixedEn: Read the whole sentence and choose the PASS expression that gives the same meaning.
fixedVariable.variableZh: 保留原句中的人物、事物、時間、結果和意思。；在本練習中,around 和 round 可以表達相同意思;pass as 和 pass for 也可以表達相同的核心意思。；請仔細留意語序。不同位置會表達不同意思,例如 pass over the hospital 表示從醫院上空經過,而 pass him over for promotion 表示升職時沒有考慮他。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time, result and meaning. Around and round can express the same meaning in this set. Pass as and pass for can also express the same central idea. Read the word order carefully: pass it on pass them out pass the phone over pass him by pass over the hospital pass him over for promotion

benefits.titleZh: 清楚談論移動、路線和時間
benefits.titleEn: Talk clearly about movement, routes and time
benefits.zh: PASS 表達可以描述人或車輛經過、從上方越過、路經某地,以及時間逐漸過去。
benefits.en: PASS expressions can describe people or vehicles going past, moving overhead, travelling through a place and time going by.

benefits.titleZh: 說明事物如何在人與人或不同世代之間傳遞
benefits.titleEn: Explain how things move from one person or generation to another
benefits.zh: 你可以 pass messages on、pass papers out、pass food round、pass stories down,以及 passcontrol over to somebody。
benefits.en: You can pass messages on, pass papers out, pass food round, pass stories down and pass control over to somebody.

benefits.titleZh: 描述選擇、錯過機會和不公平決定
benefits.titleEn: Describe choices, missed chances and unfair decisions
benefits.zh: pass something up 可以表示放棄機會;pass somebody over 可以表示沒有挑選某人;passsomebody by 則可描述機會與某人擦身而過。
benefits.en: Pass something up describes refusing a chance. Pass somebody over describes not choosing them, while pass somebody by can describe opportunities being missed.

benefits.titleZh: 談論活動、困難時期和較敏感的人生轉變
benefits.titleEn: Talk about events, difficult periods and sensitive life changes
benefits.zh: pass off 可以描述活動如何進行;pass through 可以描述一段經歷;pass out 表示昏倒;passaway 則是表示某人去世的較委婉說法。
benefits.en: Pass off describes how an event happens, pass through describes an experience, pass out means to faint, and pass away is a gentle way to say that somebody died.
